baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual noun عينان and dual verb تجريان in فيهما عينان تجريان.
baseline_models.mechanism: عين supplies two source-points and جري supplies their active outflow, so the focus depicts paired water origins whose defining condition is movement rather than storage.

activation_trace.role: A spring or visible water-source supplies the two source-points in the mechanism.
Running and flowing supplies the continuous outward motion of both sources.

changed_reading.before: Two unspecified things occupy an unresolved dual container.
changed_reading.after: Two spring-sources in each unresolved domain are actively flowing, with source and motion fused into one hydraulic event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عينان can name eye-like water openings, while تجريان predicates flow of both.
baseline_models.mechanism: The thin-hole branch of عين shifts attention from bodies of water to outlet geometry: each عين is an aperture through which water escapes, and the dual verb makes the two apertures parallel channels.

activation_trace.role: An eye-like hole from which water seeps supplies the outlet geometry.
Flow turns each opening into an operating channel rather than a static recess.

changed_reading.before: The eyes are simply two pools or springs.
changed_reading.after: The eyes may be twin outlet apertures, emphasizing permeability and delivery rather than stored water.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordinary eye branch remains available in عينان, and تجريان can activate coordinated movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A perceptual reading coexists with the hydraulic one: two seeing positions move or keep pace through each domain, making the scene capable of being continuously witnessed rather than merely watered.

activation_trace.role: The bodily seeing eye supplies two perceptual positions.
Keeping pace supplies coordinated movement for the two viewpoints.

changed_reading.before: Only water moves through the two domains.
changed_reading.after: A secondary layer lets paired viewpoints keep pace through them, turning flow into continuous witnessing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disclosure, recognition by an effect, visible marking, and gaze converge on the عين branches of direct sight and watchful care. The flowing eyes can therefore remain springs while also functioning as continuously manifest evidence that the two domains are seen and tended.

activation_trace.role: Direct eyewitness presence makes the water-sources vehicles of manifest encounter.
Watchful care supplies the tending function layered onto the springs.
A running customary course makes that visible care continuous rather than episodic.
Emergence into visibility supplies the disclosure side of the mechanism.
Recognition through an effect or sign makes visible evidence consequential.
A mark whose condition is read by an observer supplies legible manifestation.
Eye and gaze reactivate the perceptual register near the focus scene.

structural_cues: The surah moves from disclosure at 55:4 to recognition by visible marks at 55:41 and gaze at 55:56, repeatedly reactivating sight around عينان.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visibility, recognition, marking, gaze, and the عين branches; I infer that the springs themselves display ongoing attentive care. A live alternative is that these are independent sight motifs with no personifying force on 55:50.

changed_reading.before: The springs irrigate but do not signify beyond their material function.
changed_reading.after: The paired springs also make care continuously visible, as if each domain bears an open eye of provision and attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counted course, alignment between counterparts, and the water-specific danger of exceeding a limit revise جريان from sheer abundance into calibrated throughput. The two flows are plentiful because they remain in proportion, not because they flood without bound.

activation_trace.role: The spring branch supplies the water whose rate and relation can be calibrated.
Continuous flow supplies the process subjected to measure and limit.
Counting and calculation supply the model of an ordered course.
Alignment between two things supplies proportional coordination of the dual flows.
Water rising into sweeping force supplies the physical failure mode that calibrated flow avoids.
The parallel mapped water-transgression branch reinforces overflow as the relevant limit case.

structural_cues: Dual morphology in 55:50 follows measured cosmic courses and three balance commands in 55:5-9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, bilateral alignment, and water that exceeds its limit; I infer that these principles govern the later dual flow. The live alternative is that the balance passage is ethical-cosmic framing without hydraulic transfer.

changed_reading.before: The two springs are valuable because water pours freely.
changed_reading.after: Their gift is controlled continuity: two proportioned flows that sustain abundance without becoming an overrunning flood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier two-water scene combines release or mixing, convergence, an interspace, and refusal of aggressive overrun. This changes the two eyes from duplicate ornaments into counterpart currents whose relation is managed: they can approach and interact while retaining a boundary.

activation_trace.role: Two springing source-points supply the paired hydraulic actors.
Keeping pace supplies coordinated relation rather than two unrelated motions.
Mixing and disturbance supply the possibility of interaction between released waters.
The paired broad waters supply the large-scale analogue for the paired springs.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies convergence without assumed identity.
An interspace between two things supplies the separating interface.
Crossing a limit by aggression supplies the boundary violation that the system excludes.

structural_cues: The paired subjects and dual verb of 55:19 recur as paired subjects and a dual verb in 55:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a two-water architecture of meeting, interspace, and non-overrun; I transfer that architecture from seas to springs. A live alternative is that the two passages share only dual imagery, not one hydraulic rule.

changed_reading.before: Each spring is an independent duplicate inside each domain.
changed_reading.after: The two springs form a bounded pair-system, coordinated enough to meet or keep pace but differentiated enough not to erase one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punitive scene cycles subjects between two stations and boiling water, while the focus lets water itself run. The contrast gives تجريان a directional and releasing quality: blessed motion proceeds as an open course, whereas punitive motion traps the mover in recurrence.

activation_trace.role: Running flow supplies the open trajectory whose value changes under contrast.
Circling around supplies the opposed closed-loop motion.
An intermediate state between endpoints supplies the oscillating corridor.
Hot water supplies the destructive destination opposed to life-bearing flow.

structural_cues: Both scenes coordinate motion with a two-place or between construction, but mover, medium, and outcome reverse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circling between punitive endpoints and, separately, running water; I infer an ethical-spatial contrast between closed and open trajectories. A live alternative is that no direct contrast is intended across the scenes.

changed_reading.before: جريان merely says that the water moves.
changed_reading.after: Its motion is a non-captive course, an open delivery of life set against forced circulation between destructive endpoints.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context resolves فيهما as two tree-screened gardens and immediately characterizes them by branching extension. The flowing eyes can now be read as internal circulation feeding a ramified living structure, not as water placed decoratively beside it.

activation_trace.role: The springing source supplies the internal water origin.
Flow supplies circulation from source through the living enclosure.
A garden screened by trees resolves the dual container and supplies a living enclosure.
Extending, ramified branches supply the network that the water can sustain.

structural_cues: 55:46 supplies the dual antecedent for فيهما, and 55:48 places dual branching immediately before the dual springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two wooded enclosures, ramified branches, and flowing springs; I infer a source-to-branch circulation system. A live alternative is a non-causal inventory of adjacent garden features.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds two attractive water features to two gardens.
changed_reading.after: It locates twin internal circulatory sources that keep each branching garden alive from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence labels the scene a benefit, follows it with paired fruit, and brings harvest close. Activated by the ongoing-grant branch of جري, the water becomes provisioning infrastructure whose continuous delivery produces accessible paired yield.

activation_trace.role: The spring supplies the material source of the provision.
An ongoing grant supplies continuity and converts flow into sustained provision.
Benefits and favors classify the flow by its received value.
Pleasant fruit supplies the concrete yield of the water system.
A counterpart joined to its mate carries the focus duality into the yield.
Taking produce from its growth-place supplies the harvest stage of the mechanism.
Nearness makes the resulting yield continuously accessible.

structural_cues: The local sequence is flowing sources at 55:50, benefit refrain at 55:51, paired fruit at 55:52, and near harvest at 55:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuous-grant potential, benefit, fruit, pairing, harvest, and nearness; I infer the causal arrow from water delivery to accessible yield. A live alternative is that the sequence lists rewards without specifying irrigation as cause.

changed_reading.before: The springs are an ornamental amenity among other rewards.
changed_reading.after: They are a continuing provisioning circuit whose paired flow issues in paired, readily gathered produce.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact later frame فيهما عينان repeats source, number, and container but replaces running with forceful upwelling and dispersed spray. That controlled substitution differentiates تجريان as steady directed continuity rather than maximum pressure or volume.

activation_trace.role: The focus spring supplies the repeated entity held constant across the comparison.
Running flow supplies the focus manner whose precision emerges by contrast.
The repeated pair of springs fixes the comparison while the predicate changes.
Water welling forcefully supplies the pressure contrast to steady running.
Dispersed spray supplies a second contrast to directed course.

structural_cues: 55:50 and 55:66 share the exact dual container-plus-source frame and differ at the final dual predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact syntactic repetition with a predicate substitution; I infer deliberate manner contrast between steady course and forceful or dispersed emission. The live alternative is stylistic variation without ranking or hydraulic distinction.

changed_reading.before: تجريان is a generic synonym for abundant spring water.
changed_reading.after: تجريان marks the first pair by steady, directed, sustained course, distinct from the later pair's forceful gushing or spray.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax and nearby garden setting strongly favor water-sources. It remains branch-anchored in عين as scout and جري as commissioned agent, with later recognition imagery supporting an observational task. Render it only as exploratory personification or semantic resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عينان supplies two watchers and تجريان supplies their commissioned movement.

activation_trace.role: A scout or sentinel sent as a group's eye supplies the paired observers.
An agent or envoy running an affair supplies commissioned movement.
Sight reaching a whole field supplies the sentinels' imagined observational range.
Recognition from an effect or mark supplies an observational task.

changed_reading.before: Two water-sources run in each garden.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of personification, each garden also has two commissioned sentinels moving through it and recognizing what becomes visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This legal-economic activation is far from the garden's immediate material sense, but both focus roots directly license present tangible wealth and an ongoing grant, while later recompense and enduring benefit make the mechanism coherent. Render it as an analogy of provision or endowment, explicitly subordinate to the spring reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عينان activates two present assets and تجريان activates their continuing disbursement.

activation_trace.role: Present tangible wealth supplies two immediately available assets rather than deferred claims.
A continuing stipend or grant supplies recurring yield from those assets.
An act met by its recompense supplies the return relation.
The repeated doing of good supplies the quality shared by contribution and return.
Stable, growing good supplies enduring increase rather than one-time payout.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a transient visual abundance of water.
changed_reading.after: It can also figure two present endowments whose beneficial yield keeps being disbursed as a fitting, durable return.

strongest_changes: Running became calibrated continuity through the earlier balance and non-overflow complex, then gained precision against the later gushing pair.
The dual springs became a bounded counterpart system rather than redundant ornaments, echoing waters that meet without overrun.
The resolved garden antecedent and nearby branching turned the springs into internal circulation that issues in paired, accessible yield.
Sight branches remained live beside the hydraulic sense, allowing the water to manifest attentive care without collapsing the two readings.
summary.what_was_special: The exact 55:66 repetition holds فيهما عينان constant while changing only the dual predicate, making manner of flow unusually diagnostic. At the same time, عين and جري support perceptual, agentive, and economic branches that preserve several contained readings alongside the strong ecological-hydraulic model.
remaining_uncertainties: The perceptual and sentry layers are branch-licensed but not demanded by the local syntax.
Transfer of balance and sea-boundary mechanics to the garden springs is abductive rather than explicitly causal.
The contrast between running and gushing may mark hydraulic quality or hierarchy, but it may also be stylistic variation.
The economic endowment reading is coherent across branches yet remains a cross-domain analogy, not a direct lexical rendering.
